beats.subtitle: 接班人的取舍
beats.zh: 董事会最终选择了更年轻的硬件负责人
beats.en: The board ultimately chooses the younger hardware leader.

beats.subtitle: 软硬件重新结合
beats.zh: 新领导层意味着更重视硬件创新和软硬协同
beats.en: The next era emphasizes hardware innovation and integration.

beats.subtitle: 新形态硬件的窗口
beats.zh: 端侧 AI、可穿戴与新形态设备正在成为方向
beats.en: On-device AI, wearables, and new devices shape the roadmap.

beats.subtitle: 苹果的下一阶段
beats.zh: 未来的关键是如何把算力、系统和产品重新结合
beats.en: The next task is to reunite compute, systems, and products.

beats.subtitle: Vision Pro 与端侧 AI
beats.zh: 新产品形态要从展示技术变成真实体验
beats.en: New forms must become real experiences, not just demos.

beats.subtitle: 成熟业务与新增量
beats.zh: 服务业务已经成熟，新体验才是增长空间
beats.en: Services are mature; new experiences create the next growth space.

beats.subtitle: 库克留下的能力
beats.zh: 库克仍会以经验支持新任 CEO 的过渡
beats.en: Cook's experience continues to support the transition.

beats.subtitle: 乐观与担忧并存
beats.zh: 有人看好端侧 AI，也有人认为苹果起步太慢
beats.en: Some favor Apple's AI future; others fear it is late.

beats.subtitle: 算力如何变成体验
beats.zh: 真正的问题不是 AI 标签，而是它如何进入产品
beats.en: The question is not the AI label, but how it enters products.

beats.subtitle: 不必预言未来
beats.zh: 未来无法预言，但工程能力值得被认真看待
beats.en: The future is unknown, but engineering capacity matters.

beats.subtitle: 从厚实基础走向创新
beats.zh: 积累足够厚实，下一任掌舵人才能放手创新
beats.en: A strong base gives the next leader room to innovate.

beats.subtitle: 运营机器留下的基础
beats.zh: 库克时代为苹果积累了极其丰厚的能力
beats.en: The Cook era leaves Apple an exceptionally strong foundation.

beats.subtitle: 产品才是最终答案
beats.zh: 作为消费者，我们期待的不是数字，而是下一次惊喜
beats.en: As consumers, we want the next great surprise, not just metrics.

beats.subtitle: 体验必须足够出色
beats.zh: 只要产品足够强，苹果就仍然值得期待
beats.en: If the product is strong enough, Apple remains worth watching.

beats.subtitle: 你看好特纳斯吗
beats.zh: 这就是本期视频：你看好特纳斯开启的新时代吗？
beats.en: Do you believe in the Ternus era?
